text.tspan: One giant state → small states by env / region / layer
Move without recreating (1.7+): old stack removed { from = aws_db_instance.app lifecycle { destroy = false } }
new stack import { to = aws_db_instance.app id = "app-prod" } → both plans: 0 to destroy
older: terraform state pull → state mv -state=old.tfstate -state-out=new.tfstate → state push · within one state: moved { from to }
Back up both states first (terraform state pull > backup.tfstate). Take out what doesn't belong (K8s apps → Argo CD).
Rule of thumb: one state = what one team changes together, plan finishes in a minute or two. -target is not a fix.
